name: Power Corrupts
source:
Play a newly manifested superhuman in a morally gray world
What you can take is limited only by your grasp, as long as you can handle the consequences.
Ultimately the player's path is their own, hero or villain, famous or infamous.
Play a male or female character, straight, gay, or bisexual
Choose from a variety of powers to use or misuse
Visual novel elements within a sandbox framework
Pursue a relationship, or use your powers to take what you want
No grinding - advancement is steady
Choice-based tactical combat options - no random outcomes
Placeholder art will be replaced as funding increases
